items.title: Securities Fraud Investigation Into Innventure, Inc. (INV) Continues – Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz
items.summary: Innventure, Inc. reported disappointing Q2 2026 results on August 13, 2026, missing earnings and revenue consensus estimates significantly and suspending its 2026 guidance for its Accelsius division. The company cited challenges in the AI infrastructure market including power availability and GPU access constraints for smaller companies. The stock fell 55.1% to $1.62 per share on August 14, 2026, prompting a securities fraud investigation.

items.title: Innventure, Inc. (INV) Shareholders Who Lost Money – Contact Law Offices of Howard G. Smith About Securities Fraud Investigation
items.summary: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith is investigating Innventure, Inc. for possible federal securities law violations. On August 13, 2026, Innventure reported disappointing Q2 2026 results with a loss per share of $0.32 (missing consensus by $0.15) and revenue of $953,000 (missing by $1.02 million). The company suspended its 2026 revenue and cash flow targets for Accelsius, citing challenges in the AI infrastructure market including power availability and GPU access constraints for smaller companies. The stock fell 55.1% to $1.62 per share on August 14, 2026.
